text: Dr Wale Towolawi – Wilton Dental Practice
BDS, FDSRCS (Eng), MBBS (Lond), PG Dip Clin Derm (Lond)

Popularly known as Dr. Wale by his patients, he qualified as a dentist from the College of Medicine, University of Lagos in 1985. After beginning his postgraduate training, he moved to the UK to specialize in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery. He gained extensive experience working in several hospitals across the UK and achieved his Fellowship from the Royal College of Surgeons of England in 1992.

A year later, Dr. Wale pursued further studies in medicine and qualified as a medical doctor from Imperial College, University of London in 1998. Following his hospital internship, he advanced his expertise in dental implantology through further training at Old Trafford, Manchester, in 2000.
Dr. Wale also has a strong interest in aesthetic medicine. In 2007, he completed a Postgraduate Diploma in Clinical Dermatology from Queen Mary’s University of London.
Currently, Dr. Wale practices in London, Milton Keynes, and Kent as a Specialist Oral Surgeon, Implantologist, and Intravenous Sedationist.

Beyond his clinical work, Dr. Wale has a passion for music, computing, digital graphics, photography, and artificial intelligence. His clinics offer a calm and welcoming atmosphere, enhanced by soothing music and aromatherapy. He also enjoys lawn tennis, basketball, and traveling.
